ArcelorMittal reported a group‑wide lost‑time injury frequency rate (LTIFR) of **0.70** for 2024.  
The company defines LTIFR as **“Lost Time Injuries (LTI) per 1,000,000 worked hours (own personnel and contractors)”** (Glossary, [3]).  
A lost‑time injury (LTI) is defined as **“an incident that causes an injury that prevents a person from returning to his/her next scheduled shift or work period”** (Glossary, [3]).
